history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration conduct project audits within the time frame prescribed in the operational handbook for country-based pooled funds and carry out the financial spot checks in an effective manner by referring to the previous financial spot check and external audit outputs.
history.administration_response: Management requests that this recommendation be closed. With the issuance in December 2022 of the new global guidelines for country- based pooled funds, updated time frames for conducting project audits and enhanced templates and guidance for financial spot checks were provided in section 5.4.6, paragraph 282. The new guidelines were to be reconfigured into country-level operational manuals throughout the first two quarters of 2023.
history.board_assessment: Given that, on a sample basis, the Board noted that 17 of the 21 audits required for projects granted in 2022 were overdue as of April 2023 and that country-level operational manuals have not yet been finalized, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration conduct project audits within the time frame prescribed in the operational handbook for country-based pooled funds and carry out the financial spot checks in an effective manner by referring to the previous financial spot check and external audit outputs.
history.administration_response: With the issuance in December 2022 of the new global guidelines for country-based pooled funds, the time frame for conducting project audits was increased from seven to nine months. An updated template for financial spot checks was implemented and has been in use since March 2023. However, the template is being reviewed, as requested by Humanitarian Financing Units during the most recent global fund managers’ workshop, held in June 2024. A more recent update of the spot check template is being drafted by a designated working group and is expected to be finalized by the third quarter of 2025. Given that the guidance has been formulated and is now being updated further, this recommendation is considered to be implemented and its closure is requested.
history.board_assessment: Given that the time frame for conducting project audits has been updated in the new global guidelines for country-based pooled funds and the updated spot check template has been drafted, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
